race.title: Great British Bonus Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: There's a chance this could be a pipe-opener for LARGY FORCE back over hurdles after 6 months off but she would prove very hard to beat if she does replicate her chasing form. Capricciose showed a fair bit in bumpers and is expected to step up on her hurdles debut, while Emiko is an interesting debutant over hurdles. LARGY FORCE (IRE) CAPRICCIOSE (IRE) EMIKO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Capricciose (9/4), Largy Force (3/1), Golden Bouquet (9/2), Emiko (6/1), Vrheligonne (6/1), Hollie Potter (14/1), Safari (20/1), Millady (25/1), Levant Lady (25/1), Farm Assured (50/1), Tierbay (100/1)
